summary.text: Raisheda Angus is an independent candidate for Ohio State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working in broadcasting.

paragraphs.text: Raisheda Angus earned a high school diploma from West High School and a degree from the Ohio Media School in 2018, and she also attended Columbus State Community College.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Angus described herself as a grassroots candidate and listed immigration policy and education and health care reform among her key campaign messages.
